prompt_library.signature_symbol_base: Create a premium SummitReady mountain-progression symbol for a high-end outdoor adventure app. Minimal geometric vector-style construction, strong silhouette, precise clean edges, sophisticated rather than playful, inspired by alpine topography and mountaineering equipment without copying another brand. Designed to remain recognisable at 20–32 px but detailed enough for a larger 96 px presentation. Dark-interface compatible. Primarily monochrome/light form with restrained SummitReady electric blue/green accent where appropriate. No text, no letters, no gradients that depend on a background, no mockup, no phone, no scenery, no drop-shadow baked into the asset. Transparent background. Square composition with generous safe area. Production icon/brand-symbol quality.
prompt_library.rank_base: Create a premium mountaineering rank emblem for SummitReady. Modern alpine expedition insignia, refined and collectible, credible enough for serious hikers and mountaineers, not cartoonish and not gaming/fantasy artwork. Strong central mountain-related silhouette, restrained geometric detail, dark-interface compatible, transparent background, no text embedded in the artwork, no mockup, no phone, no external background. Maintain exactly the same visual system, proportions, lighting language and emblem construction across all seven ranks. The series must visibly progress in prestige and mountain sophistication.
prompt_library.achievement_base: Create a premium SummitReady achievement badge belonging to a coherent alpine achievement collection. Modern outdoor expedition identity, strong simple central symbol, dark UI compatible, sophisticated and credible, not cartoonish, not childish and not esports/gaming style. Transparent background. No text embedded in artwork. Designed to work from 40 px to 120 px. Consistent border/emblem geometry across the entire collection.
prompt_library.editorial_base: Premium cinematic outdoor editorial photography for SummitReady, a serious mountain training and adventure app. Authentic mountain environment, realistic weather and terrain, natural human scale, physically credible hiking/mountaineering equipment and posture, dramatic but believable natural light, deep atmospheric mountain layers, restrained natural colour palette, sophisticated Berghaus/Arc'teryx-style outdoor editorial feeling without copying any brand campaign. Composition must leave intentional negative space for mobile UI overlays. No text, no logos, no phone mockup, no advertising graphics, no impossible terrain, no fantasy mountains, no oversaturated HDR, no obvious AI artefacts. Landscape master suitable for intelligent mobile crops.
